text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM): under AXON_MAX_STEPS / AXON_WALL_MS (or a ceiling's steps / wall_ms) a lambda-body entry is now one step on both engines, so callback-only work (arr_map, arr_fold) stops with E1006, exit 9; the VM's fold-leaf tier declines under either bound. The run-wide meters (steps, the wall-clock start, ai_calls, the AXON_BUDGET_TOKENS / ai_tokens charge) are per process, so axon test spends one budget across its tests instead of restarting it per test. --ceiling and AXON_CEILING naming one file in two spellings are one ceiling (canonical paths compared); two different files stay E1007. Runs with no ceiling are unchanged.
